issue.title: Doctor: flag stale active-location artifacts (plans for closed issues, active defs with completed status, ghost changelogs)

description: Make the stale-active-location drift class (uncovered by the #300 deep dive) permanently visible in tiki_doctor / the Diagnostics panel, with one-shot Fix actions that reuse #300's move semantics.

successCriteria.description: A def with status 'completed' placed in active releases/ produces a Diagnostics finding with a working Fix that archives it
An active plan for an issue in history produces a staleActivePlans finding; Fix archives the plan; plans for issues currently in activeWork (including current-release children) are NOT flagged
A changelog-only ghost release (v0.7.4 fixture) is reported by the widened missing-json check
unverifiedShippedCriteria stays bounded after #300's migration: recency cutoff applied, tested, and documented in the check's doc comment
Each new rule covered by summary/unit tests including the healthy negative case; all gates green (pnpm build, desktop vitest, cargo tests, framework suite, lint zero errors)

phases.title: Rust doctor read-side: staleActivePlans field, ghost-changelog widening, unverifiedShippedCriteria cutoff
phases.content: In state.rs add StaleActivePlan {issue: u32, plan_path: String, newest_timestamp: Option<String>} (camelCase serde) and a #[serde(default)] stale_active_plans: Vec<StaleActivePlan> field on DiagnosticsReport. In commands.rs: (a) add compute_stale_active_plans(tiki_path) scanning plans/*.json (top-level only) whose issue number is in history.recentIssues / history.lastCompletedIssue / any history.recentReleases[].issues, EXCLUDING any issue present in activeWork (any status, issue entries by number and release entries' release.issues lists) — Value-based traversal so a degraded state.json never fails the scan; newest_timestamp = max ISO string among auditedAt, createdAt, phases[].completedAt/startedAt. (b) widen compute_recent_releases_missing_json to also treat releases/*-changelog.md and releases/archive/*-changelog.md stems as candidate versions (v0.7.4 ghost class). (c) add a 30-day recency cutoff to compute_unverified_shipped_criteria using chrono (already a dependency): include a plan's criteria only when its newest parseable timestamp (auditedAt, phases[].completedAt, createdAt) is within 30 days of now; plans with no parseable timestamp are excluded; document the choice in the doc comment. Update the #281 fixtures to carry recent createdAt values and add cargo tests: stale plan flagged / activeWork-issue excluded / release-child excluded / not-in-history excluded; changelog-only ghost reported and non-ghost not; cutoff includes recent + excludes ancient/timestampless plans; serialization test that staleActivePlans key crosses IPC in camelCase.
verification: cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && cargo test --lib (or cargo check --tests if exe locked)
phases.summary: Rust doctor read-side: staleActivePlans field+struct, changelog-ghost widening, 30-day unverified-SC cutoff; cargo --lib 95 green

phases.title: Rust fix commands: archive_stale_release_defs + archive_stale_plans
phases.content: Add two Tauri commands in commands.rs mirroring migrate-stale-artifacts.mjs move semantics, both returning Result<usize,String> (count moved) and skipping unreadable/unparseable files or existing archive destinations with log::warn, never failing the whole run. archive_stale_release_defs: scan releases/*.json (top-level), for each def with status != 'active': rewrite status to 'shipped' when it was completed/shipped (leave not_planned as-is; location is the fix), atomic-write, then rename into releases/archive/. archive_stale_plans: recompute compute_stale_active_plans, for each flagged plan normalize phases[].status (anything not completed/skipped -> completed, mirroring the migration), atomic-write, rename into plans/archive/. Register both in lib.rs invoke_handler. Cargo tests: only status!=active defs move (active-location active def untouched, archive dest collision skipped), moved def says shipped; only flagged plans move, phases normalized, excluded plans untouched.
verification: cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && cargo test --lib (or cargo check --tests if exe locked)
phases.summary: archive_stale_release_defs + archive_stale_plans Tauri commands registered; cargo --lib 98, clippy --all-targets clean

phases.title: Frontend summary rules: staleActiveReleaseDefs + staleActivePlans
phases.content: In diagnosticsSummary.ts: mirror the new staleActivePlans field ({issue, planPath, newestTimestamp}[]) on DiagnosticsReport; extend Finding.action union with 'archiveStaleReleaseDefs' | 'archiveStalePlans'. Add rule A: releaseChecks rows with location==='active' && status!=='active' -> WARN finding (genuine drift, unlike archivedButActive) listing versions, action archiveStaleReleaseDefs. Add rule B: staleActivePlans non-empty -> WARN finding listing issue numbers, action archiveStalePlans. Update the recentReleasesMissingJson message to reflect the widened source (history or changelog stems). Update the header doc comment. Vitest: stale active def flagged as warn+action / active-status active-location def NOT flagged / archived rows never flagged by rule A; staleActivePlans non-empty flagged with action / empty no finding; cleanReport fixture gains staleActivePlans: [].
phases.summary: diagnosticsSummary warn rules + Fix actions, widened missing-json message; desktop vitest 276

phases.title: DiagnosticsPanel wiring + full gates
phases.content: In DiagnosticsPanel.tsx: generalize the #276 normalize pattern into a runFix(command) helper; render Fix buttons for archiveStaleReleaseDefs (invokes archive_stale_release_defs) and archiveStalePlans (invokes archive_stale_plans) when the matching finding action is present, then re-run load(). Render the staleActivePlans list (issue, planPath, newestTimestamp) mirroring the unverifiedShippedCriteria section. Run all gates: pnpm build, pnpm --filter=@tiki/desktop test, cargo test --lib (or check --tests if locked), framework suite (cd packages/framework && node --test __tests__/*.test.mjs), pnpm -C apps/desktop lint (zero errors).
phases.summary: DiagnosticsPanel runFix generalization + staleActivePlans list; all gates green
